claim: Hoge Kempen National Park has nine gateways including Terhills, Kattevennen, Station As, Lieteberg, Pietersheim, Mechelse Heide, Thorpark, Duinengordel and Bergerven (some still under development).
quote: Terhills (Maasmechelen) ... Kattevennen (Genk) ... As Railway Station (As) ... Lieteberg (Zutendaal) ... Pietersheim (Lanaken) ... Mechelse Heide (Maasmechelen) ... Thorpark ... Duinengordel ... Bergerven

claim: Mechelse Heide gateway (Joseph Smeetslaan 280, 3630 Maasmechelen) has seven hiking loops, a 1.5km wheelchair-accessible Zandloperpad through a former sand quarry, a dedicated dog play area, kids' Beestige Boelbos and KIDSAFARI, but no visitors' lounge — 'Nature speaks for itself'.
quote: Address: Joseph Smeetslaan 280, 3630 Maasmechelen ... Seven hiking loops originate from this gateway ... Zandloperpad (Sandpiper Path) is a 1.5km wheelchair-accessible paved track ... there is no visitors' lounge here. Nature speaks for itself!

claim: The Mechelse Heide panorama point sits at 104 metres above sea level, the highest spot in the National Park, with views on a clear day as far as Germany and the High Fens.
quote: 104 meters above sea level ... enormous views here as far as the Netherlands and in clear weather even as far as Germany and the High Fens ... the highest point in the National Park

claim: Kattevennen (Planetariumweg 19, Genk) offers a 150-space car park with 2 EV chargers and space for 12 mobile homes; the gateway is open year-round Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 and Sun 13:00–17:00, with Saturday 13:00–17:00 added 1 April–31 October.
quote: open all year from Monday to Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and on Sunday from 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. From April 1st to October 31st, it is also open on Saturdays ... large car park of 150 parking spaces and space for 12 mobile homes ... 2 charging stations

claim: Kattevennen is themed around stars and planets, anchored by the Cosmodrome planetarium and offering six hiking loops (four starting at the gate) plus cycling, MTB, horse riding, mini-golf and a playground.
quote: gateway to your Cosmic-Adventure with Cosmodrome ... 6 hiking loops, with four starting from the entrance gate ... hiking, cycling, mountain biking, horse riding, mini-golf and romping on the playground

claim: Station As gateway (Stationsstraat 124, 3665 As) features a 31m André-Dumont-derrick replica viewing tower, an experience train, a 1,300m miniature narrow-gauge train, forest golf and disc golf; visitor centre open 1 April–8 November, Tue–Sun 09:30–17:00.
quote: 31-meter tall lookout tower ... replica of the derrick with which André Dumont discovered the first coal in Limburg ... 1,300-metre-long narrow gauge track ... April 1st–November 8th, Tuesday–Sunday, 9:30 AM–12:00 PM and 12:30 PM–5:00 PM

claim: Lieteberg's signature attraction is a ~3km barefoot path (Blotevoetenpad) with wood, stones, chips, grass, loam and water sections, a labyrinth, and an 18m wooden watchtower; the experience lasts about 90 minutes and costs €7.50.
quote: close to 3 km and is only accessible barefoot ... wood, stones, tree chips, grass, loam and water ... 18-metre-high wooden watchtower ... entry fee is €7.50 ... lasts around 90 minutes

claim: Lieteberg visitor centre (Stalkerweg 46, 3690 Zutendaal) offers free parking; the walking area is accessible daily sunrise to sunset and the Butterfly Garden is open 1 May–30 September.
quote: Stalkerweg 46, 3690 Zutendaal ... parking is free ... daily from sunrise to sunset ... Butterfly Garden (Vlindertuin) is open from May 1 through September 30

claim: Thor Park (André Dumontlaan 67, 3600 Genk) offers 10 hiking loops including the 2km Steenmannetjespad and an 11km grey route, sits on 10 km² of former Waterschei mining land mixing slag heaps with heath and pine, and includes the Lichtsporen light-art trail.
quote: André Dumontlaan 67, 3600 Genk ... Steenmannetjespad: 2 km ... Grey walking route: 11 km ... 10 km² on former mining land ... Lichtsporen light art installation

claim: Pietersheim gateway in Lanaken is built around the 12th-century Waterburcht water castle on a 76ha former royal estate, with eight signposted hiking loops (four from the gate), a floating walkway accessible to less mobile visitors, and a petting zoo with playground.
quote: Romanesque castle ruin at the Pietersembos ... former royal estate 'Pietersheim' (covering 76 ha) features the 12th-century 'Waterburcht' ... eight signposted hiking loops, four of which start at the entrance gate ... petting zoo with playground

claim: 'Fietsen door de Heide' is a 4km bike path between cycle nodes 550 and 551 across the 700ha Mechelse Heide, with a nearly 300m wooden bicycle bridge giving a panoramic view over the heath; it opened July 2021 as the third Visit Limburg 'cycling-through' experience.
quote: bikepath of 4 km ... cycle nodes 550 and 551 ... 700 hectares one of the largest heathland areas in Flanders ... almost 300 meter long wooden bicycle bridge ... opened in July 2021

claim: Terhills (formerly Connecterra) is the main gateway and houses the National Park Visitor Center; trails climb three terrils (mine waste heaps) on the former Eisden coal mine site, with the green 3.6km loop reaching the Lange Terril panorama point.
quote: Terhills (formerly Connecterra, Maasmechelen) is the main gateway ... National Park Visitor Center ... three terrils (mine waste heaps) and shaft headframes ... green route of 3.6 km brings you in one hour over the long terril to the panorama point

claim: Hoge Kempen uses self-reliant year-round grazers — Norwegian Fjord horses, Konik horses, Angus cattle and donkeys — to maintain landscape variation, while the adjacent Rivierpark Maasvallei is grazed almost exclusively by Galloways and Koniks creating mosaic open grassland.
quote: Norwegian Fjord horses, Konikpaarden, Angus cattle, and even donkeys ... Along the Maas you see almost exclusively Galloway cattle and Konikpaarden ... mosaic patterns of open grassland and scrub

claim: The purple heather (Calluna vulgaris) at Mechelse Heide blooms from mid-August to mid-September, the peak visiting window for the signature purple-heath panorama.
quote: the purple heathland and expansive vistas are particularly beautiful in August and September

claim: All seven eastern Hoge Kempen gateways sit within 30 km of Opglabbeek by road: Mechelse Heide ~5 km, Station As neighbouring, Genk (Kattevennen, Thor Park) ~13 km, Maasmechelen (Terhills) ~15 km, Zutendaal (Lieteberg) ~10–15 km, Lanaken (Pietersheim) ~17 km.
quote: Maasmechelen to Opglabbeek: 15.5 km ... 18 minutes ... Genk and Opglabbeek is 8 miles ... De Mechelse Heide is located 4.97 km from Opglabbeek
